blocks.text: Beauty queen and model Olivia Culpo is officially a mom of two as she announced the arrival of her second child, baby boy Roman Augustus. Culpo made the announcement through her Instagram page on Sunday, Oct. 11, showing her, her football player husband Christian McCaffrey and their firstborn Colette admiring the new addition to their family. In the caption, the Miss Universe 2012 titleholder revealed her second child’s name and shared that he was born last Sept. 29. “Heart is exploding,” she said on her Instagram Stories.
